newsitem.title: USA: Genzyme to issue Tissue Repair shrs.
newsitem.headline: Genzyme to issue Tissue Repair shrs.

text.p: Genzyme Corp said Monday its board declared a dividend of 2,685,941 designated shares of Genzyme Tissue Repair common stock payable to its shareholders.

The Tissue Repair shares will be distributed on July 22 to Genzyme general shareholders of record as of July 11 in a tax-free distribution of about 0.03 share of Genzyme Tissue Repair stock for each share of Genzyme General stock owned.

Of the 2.6 million shares of Genzyme Tissue Repair stock, about 400,000 shares will be reserved for issuance upon exercise of Genzyme General stock options and warrants outstanding on the record date.
Cash will be paid for fractional shares.
Genzyme Tissue Repair designated shares are authorized shares of Genzyme Tissue Repair stock created in consideration for assets allocated from Genzyme General to Genzyme Tissue Repair.
The Board of Directors may hold these shares, sell them from time to time for the benefit of Genzyme General shareholders, or distribute them as a dividend to Genzyme General shareholders.
